seo_title: Hire Nearshore AWS Architects | TeamStation AI
meta_description: Hire elite nearshore AWS architects vetted by Axiom Cortex™ for secure, cost-efficient, and highly-available cloud infrastructure. U.S. time-zone alignment.
technical_analysis: We vet nearshore AWS architects with a scenario requiring a highly-available, multi-AZ architecture design for a web service with a 99.95% uptime SLO. The candidate must justify their choice between an Application Load Balancer and API Gateway, design IAM roles based on the principle of least privilege, and create a VPC with public and private subnets. Crucially, our nearshore AWS architects must also build in cost-governance from day one, proposing a strategy using AWS Budgets, Savings Plans, and automated instance scheduling. The final design is judged on its security posture, resiliency, and cost-efficiency. This ensures the nearshore AWS architects from our network can deliver enterprise-ready solutions that are both robust and economical, making them a trusted partner for CTOs.
intro: AWS engineers from TeamStation AI deliver production-grade systems with cognitive calibration and measurable performance.
